title: Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Alisa 'Alya' Kujou, an aloof half-Russian top student, mutters affectionate remarks in Russian to her lazy seatmate Masachika Kuze, not knowing he understands every word (to verify). The two team up to run in the student council election, while Masachika's hidden family ties to his childhood friend Yuki Suou complicate things (to verify).
